Method of Attack: Android banking trojan capable of infecting smartphones including latest Android versions
Overlay attacks (timing injects) on Android 7, 8, and 9
Gets package name of foreground app without requiring additional permissions
No Android permissions required unlike other banking trojans using Accessibility or Use Stats permissions
Impacted Systems: Android smartphones including latest Android versions
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps infected with the trojan
Indicators of Compromise: Source code leaked online and distributed on underground hacking forums
Source code version 2.5 known as 'Trump Edition'
